messages.content: The 20th century was defined by massive world changes, starting with two huge wars that reshaped politics and ending a period of peace. During the mid-century, especially after 1945, nations moved toward cooperation through new global alliances and a wave of social progress. Culture flourished through art and music that celebrated individual freedom, which eventually led to many technological breakthroughs today. These shifts created the modern world where countries work together while diverse lifestyles and ideas continue to evolve rapidly.
